dublinCore.dc:title: 119 HR 10263 IH: Halt Abusive Internet Lawsuits Act of 2026
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Fulcher introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on the Judiciary

form.official-title: To clarify the applicability of certain Federal and State laws for conducting routine digital commerce, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Halt Abusive Internet Lawsuits Act of 2026.

section.header: Applicability of certain laws to collection, processing, or disclosure of information or communications for a commercial purpose

paragraph.text: The collection, processing, or disclosure of information or communications for a commercial purpose shall give rise to no claim or enforcement action under Federal or State law with respect to pen registers, wiretapping, trap and trace, or eavesdropping, including chapter 1.5 of the Penal Code of California (commonly known as the California Invasion of Privacy Act).

paragraph.header: Expiration of certain claims and actions
paragraph.text: Any such claim or enforcement action in progress as of the date of the enactment of this Act may not be maintained, adjudicated, or arbitrated after such date.
The term commercial purpose includes the use of digital commerce for—

subparagraph.text: the operations of a business or a service provider or contractor to a business;
prompting, receiving, or responding to consumer input;
facilitating the sale or purchase of goods or services; or
any commercial or business purpose as defined under law or regulation of a State in which the collection, processing, or disclosure of information occurs.

paragraph.text: The term digital commerce means the promotion, sale, purchase, delivery, or support of products or services through connected digital networks and tools, including through the use of cookies, pixels, session replay, chatbots, tags, and analytics.
